findings.failureScenario: ImageViewerStage exposes keyboard zoom, pan, and fit handlers on a div with role=img, but the element has no tabIndex. The parent calls focus() after wheel and pointer input, yet a non-focusable div cannot receive normal keyboard focus, so keyboard-only users cannot reach the reusable stage controls.
findings.action: Make the stage intentionally focusable with tabIndex={0} and use an interactive/group semantic that matches its keyboard commands, or move these commands to an already focusable control. Preserve a visible focus indicator and test keyboard reachability.

findings.failureScenario: Audio artwork is exposed as role=button with a click handler, but the div has no tabIndex or keyboard handler. It is announced as an interactive button while remaining unreachable through Tab or Enter/Space, creating a broken reusable component contract for consumers that enable artwork playback.
findings.action: Render artwork as a native button, or add tabIndex={0} plus Enter/Space activation and keep the accessible name synchronized with playback state.
